limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The theorem is one-dimensional; it does not treat resonant amplitudes, the critical case |S|=1, stable sampling/frame bounds, or remove the higher-dimensional small-norm hypothesis. The source preprint is very recent, so unindexed contemporaneous work remains a residual literature risk. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
provenance: Extension of the irrational-rotation universal-completeness construction in arXiv:2609.20805 by replacing its small-amplitude pole and separation estimates with finite-amplitude nonresonant estimates.
record_title: Amplitude-free universal completeness for irrational-rotation quasicrystals
